# Vendored front-end libraries

Copied as plain files (no CDN at runtime, no build step). Approved at Milestone 2.

| File | Library | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| marked.min.js | marked (Markdown parser) | 12.0.2 | MIT |
| purify.min.js | DOMPurify (strips unsafe HTML from replies) | 3.1.6 | Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 |
| highlight.min.js | highlight.js (code colours) | 11.9.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
| hljs-light.css, hljs-dark.css | highlight.js GitHub themes | 11.9.0 | BSD-3-Clause |

To update: download the same file names from jsDelivr or cdnjs at a pinned version.
